name: contract-memo
title: Contract revenue assessment
for_each: select id,name from contracts order by source_id

sections.title: Obligations and evidence
sections.sql: select name,method,amount_cents,starts_on,ends_on,basis,evidence from obligations where contract_id=$1 order by source_id

sections.title: Review notes
sections.sql: select summary,owner,created_at from notes where contract_id=$1 order by created_at

name: revenue-schedule
title: Revenue schedule and recognition review
for_each: select id,name from contracts order by source_id

sections.title: Monthly record
sections.sql: select obligation,currency,month,scheduled_cents,recorded_cents,pending_cents from v_revenue_review where contract_id=$1 order by month,source_id
sections.note: For accountant review. No journal is posted to another system.

name: retention-record
title: Evidence retention review
for_each: select id,name from contracts order by source_id

sections.title: Recorded evidence
sections.sql: select name,basis,evidence from obligations where contract_id=$1 order by source_id
